commitments.detail: Providing one six-foot counter, access to a hand-washing sink, and ordinary electrical outlets.
Cafe owner agrees to provide one six-foot counter, access to a hand-washing sink, and ordinary electrical outlets for Luis's food pop-up.
Counter space from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM, $500 upfront payment, 70% sales share, 100 Tacos al Pastor, setup at 10:00 AM
